description: flush-union's boxes with the second moved off the shared face by about a tolerance (1e-7): one tolerance away, two into the first, or turned about the face's middle line so its ends move one or two tolerances in and out. Arris fails at each: a pave within the tolerance of an edge's end without being its vertex (Fault::Split, EmptySubEdge; one tolerance away and the turn by one), a piece of an edge that matches no piece of the coincident face's boundary (Fault::CommonBlock; two in), a cycle that does not turn once (Fault::Split, Turn; the turn by two) and two planes a hair off parallel with no closed form (OpError::Unsupported; the turn back by two). The desired result is a clean union at each, the flush body or the generic one (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
